Home/Web Maintenance

The Work That Happens After Launch

A website is not finished at launch; it starts ageing. Maintenance is the difference between a site that stays fast and secure and one you rebuild in three years.

Get a Free Quote

Looked After, Not Just Left Running

Unpatched software, expired certificates, broken forms and creeping page weight are all preventable. They only become emergencies when nobody is watching.

Our maintenance plans cover the routine work on a schedule, with monitoring that tells us about a problem before your customers do.

  • Core, theme and plugin updates, tested first
  • Off-site backups with verified restores
  • Security scanning and uptime monitoring
  • A monthly report you can actually read

Most Hacks Exploit Something Already Patched

Site compromises rarely involve a novel attack. They exploit a known vulnerability in a component that had an update available for months.

Keeping software current is unglamorous and it is the single most effective security measure available. We do it on a schedule and record what changed.

Talk to Us

Small Problems Found Early Stay Small

A contact form that quietly stopped sending, a certificate about to lapse, a page growing heavier each month — all cheap to fix, all expensive to ignore.

Regular checks catch these while they are still minor, which is usually worth more than the plan costs.

Process

How We Deliver

Web Design Lane believes in transparency every step of the way, keeping you in the loop with every executed plan.

Discovery

We get to know your brand, your goals, and the audience you intend to reach through conversations and discovery calls.

Strategy & Planning

We draft a tailored action plan with clear deliverables, timelines, KPIs, and the tools and platforms we will use.

Design & Build

Our team sets the plan in motion, and you are updated on progress at every stage of the build.

Launch & Support

We make every necessary retouch before launch. Only when you are satisfied do we go live — then we stay on for ongoing improvements.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you maintain sites you did not build?

Yes. We start with an audit to understand the stack and flag anything urgent, then move you onto a regular plan.

What is included in a plan?

Updates, backups, security monitoring, uptime checks, a monthly report and an allowance of support hours. Larger plans add performance work.

How quickly do you respond to problems?

Response targets are set in the plan. Site-down issues are treated as urgent regardless of tier.

Can we cancel?

Plans run month to month. You keep your site, your backups and your hosting access either way.

When Was Your Site Last Updated?

If you are not sure, that is the answer. Let us audit it and tell you where it stands.
